page.label: The street of the Sun family tavern from Along the River During the Qingming Festival, rebuilt in 3D, with a porter you can walk along it and a camera that goes all the way round
page.description: The street of the Sun family tavern from Along the River During the Qingming Festival, rebuilt in 3D from the painting: walk a porter through the crowd.
text: The street is the painting itself, laid back down on the ground it shows: from the painter’s own direction it lines up with the scroll exactly. The tavern, the restaurant beside it, the inn at the corner and the halls across the street are rebuilt as simple models dressed in their own painted timbers and tiles, so you can walk round them.

The people and animals are the painting’s own: the crowd round the storyteller, the sedan chairs and their bearers, the donkeys and porters, each cut out of the scroll and stood up where they are painted. The painting only ever shows one side of things, so a model’s far side wears its near side, mirrored.

Your walker is a porter with two baskets on a shoulder pole, borrowed from the street outside Dr. Zhao’s shop near the end of the scroll. He can go anywhere along the street, but not through a building; hold Shift to hurry. He, and everyone else, turns to face you like a paper cut-out.
The sounds are synthesized, not recorded.

pois.title: The Sun family tavern
pois.body: The largest building in the street is the Sun family’s licensed tavern, a 正店 or “main shop”. Licensed taverns brewed their own wine and sold it on to smaller inns.

pois.title: The decorated gateway
pois.body: Across its front the tavern has tied up a gateway of poles dressed with flowers, the festive entrance Meng Yuanlao says every wine shop in the capital put up at its door.

pois.title: The lamp-box sign
pois.body: A box sign by the door reads 正店. Signs like it held candles, to glow in the street at night.

pois.title: A storyteller
pois.body: A crowd has gathered in a ring round a man telling a story, some leaning in, some just passing and stopping to listen.

pois.title: An inn at the corner
pois.body: Its sign reads 久住王员外家, roughly “for long stays: Squire Wang’s house”, an inn for travellers, where the side street comes in.
